name: Amp
what: Five commands for Amp, the coding agent: start a thread, capture a window into a thread, track running threads from the menu bar.
story: A maintainer redirected it to Amp Dash X (99 downloads). That extension's author replied that it is "super basic and won't get any future updates", offered to transfer ownership, and after the auto-close asked maintainers to reconsider.

name: TickTick Cloud
what: TickTick for Windows: OAuth sign-in, six task commands and three AI tools, with tests.
story: A maintainer redirected it to TickTick+ (164 downloads). Both TickTick+ and TickTick (25,304 downloads) list macOS only, so Windows users still have no TickTick extension.

name: Coolify Ops
what: 14 commands covering the full Coolify API: applications, deployments, databases, services, servers.
story: Another contributor, then a maintainer, pointed to the existing Coolify extension (612 downloads), and its owner confirmed it's actively maintained and invited contributions. The contributor kept it for private use and closed the PR: "I'll be just using it privately for now then and if there's time consider contributing!"

name: PostgreSQL
what: A Postgres client with schema browsing, history, saved connections, and Raycast AI tools with read-only transactions and row limits.
story: A maintainer praised the safety work and pointed to Perry (69 downloads). The contributor wanted a separate extension and closed the PR.

name: Mac Updater
what: One view for updates from Homebrew casks and formulae, the Mac App Store, Sparkle, Electron, GitHub releases, npm, pip and Ruby gems.
story: The contributor fixed Greptile's first round of findings within a day, including a real shell-injection path. Later findings were still open when a maintainer pointed to App Updates (741 downloads) and Brew, and App Updates' author left the call to the team; no maintainer decision came before the stale bot closed it.

name: AI Costs Dashboard
what: Local spend tracking for Claude Code, Codex and Amp.
story: A maintainer requested changes once and the contributor didn't reply; the stale bot marked it stale 25 days later and closed it a week after that. Agent Usage, a usage and quota monitor that shipped in February 2026, has drawn 50 merged PRs from 24 authors; local spend tracking is a related but separate need.

name: LM Studio Chat
what: Chat with local models through LM Studio's API, no cloud dependency.
story: A maintainer pointed to a different LM Studio PR already in the queue, which merged; that extension has 213 downloads. Ollama AI, another way to chat with local models, has 42,591 downloads.

name: Limitless
what: Browse and analyze Limitless Pendant transcripts with Raycast AI.
story: A maintainer asked the contributor to address Greptile's suggestions; it stalled when the contributor ran out of time, even after the maintainer pinged them on X and two other contributors offered to help. There is still no Limitless extension in the Store.

name: Ramadan
what: Suhoor and Iftar times, a 30-day calendar and a menu-bar countdown, from a first-time contributor.
story: Another contributor, then a maintainer, pointed to Adhan Time (1,210 downloads) within hours. The contributor agreed to contribute there instead; no PR followed.

name: Emotecast
what: One search across 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ emotes, with sizing and animation handling.
story: A maintainer asked the contributor to work on 7TV Emotes Search (31 downloads) instead. The stale bot closed it a month later.
